verified_behaviors: Two accounts and three Key records coexist under one platform.
A duplicate Key ID is rejected before secret replacement and the original fingerprint remains unchanged.
One shell binding rotates from the original Key to the replacement without deleting either record.
Expired Key binding is rejected by default.
Guarded local HTTP probe records valid evidence without printing the Key.
System target is preview-only unless explicit risk acknowledgement and apply flags are present.
Generated zsh projection is mode 0600, preserves existing rc content, and keeps one idempotent source block.
A clean zsh process receives the selected variable without test output revealing its value.
Dashboard state reports an expiring Key while HTML and JSON exclude the synthetic secret and secret reference fields.
Documented Chinese and English activation phrases and adjacent non-trigger boundaries are present.
